interventions.dose: 1:1 fixed ratio with DALDA, ED50 1.25 mg/kg i.p. alone; combination ED50 0.43 mg/kg
ED50 2.05 mg/kg i.p. alone; combination ED50 0.48 mg/kg

combinations.readout: mechanical hypersensitivity (von Frey paw withdrawal frequency)
combinations.magnitude: combination ED50s (0.43 and 0.48 mg/kg) below individual ED50s; combination index 0.57
combinations.model: spared nerve injury (tibial-spared, SNIt) neuropathic pain
combinations.evidence_quote: The combination index was calculated to be 0.57, which confirmed the synergistic effect of CB-13 and DALDA co-administration.

combinations.readout: mechanical hyperalgesia (Randall Selitto paw withdrawal threshold)
combinations.magnitude: threshold significantly increased vs pre-drug baseline and vehicle
combinations.evidence_quote: Systemic co-administration of CB-13 (0.93 mg/kg) and DALDA (1.65 mg/kg) significantly increased paw withdrawal threshold in SNIt mice, when compared to their pre-drug baseline and the vehicle-treated group.

Three days of conditioning with CB-13 and DALDA co-administration (ED80 doses = 0.93 mg/kg and 1.65 mg/kg, respectively) produced significant (p<0.001) CPP in SNIt mice for the combination-paired chamber and a simultaneous decrease in preference for the vehicle-paired chamber (Fig. 6A.1, 6A.3).

combinations.magnitude: sub-effective doses with no effect alone significantly reduced cAMP in combination
combinations.evidence_quote: Sub-effective doses of CB-13 and DALDA that did not have any effect on the cAMP levels when administered separately were able to significantly reduce the levels of cAMP when administered in combination (Figs. 2D, 2E, and 2F).
